name: Metabolic Neurotransmission Anomaly with Epilepsy

criteria.description: Presence of recurrent unprovoked seizures consistent with epilepsy
Biochemical evidence of neurotransmitter metabolism anomaly in cerebrospinal fluid or plasma
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in neurotransmitter metabolism
Neuroimaging excluding structural brain abnormalities as primary cause
Partial or complete seizure control with metabolic or neurotransmitter-targeted therapy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of recurrent epilepsy plus biochemical evidence of neurotransmitter metabolism anomaly
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory; exclusion of other causes is essential.

pathognomonic.notes: Elevated or decreased levels of dopamine, serotonin, or GABA metabolites

searchTerms: delayed development with low muscle tone

common.symptomName: Movement disorders including dystonia and choreoathetosis
searchTerms: involuntary movements like twisting or jerking
movement problems such as dystonia or chorea

common.symptomName: Autonomic dysfunction (e.g., temperature instability, sweating abnormalities)
searchTerms: issues with temperature or sweating control

common.symptomName: Cognitive impairment ranging from mild to severe
Sleep disturbances including insomnia and fragmented sleep

occasional.symptomName: Behavioral abnormalities including irritability and hyperactivity
searchTerms: behavioral issues like irritability and hyperactivity

laboratory: Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid neurotransmitter metabolites (e.g., homovanillic acid, 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid)
Elevated plasma amino acid levels related to neurotransmitter precursors
Abnormal enzyme activity assays in neurotransmitter metabolic pathways
imaging: Normal or nonspecific brain MRI without structural lesions
Functional imaging may show altered neurotransmitter receptor binding
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as SLC6A1, GCH1, or other neurotransmitter metabolism-related genes
other: Positive response to neurotransmitter precursor supplementation or enzyme cofactor therapy

distinguishingFeatures: Severe early onset seizures with structural brain abnormalities
Multiple gene mutations unrelated to neurotransmitter metabolism

redFlags: Onset of refractory seizures in infancy or early childhood
Abnormal neurotransmitter metabolite profile in CSF
references: Orphanet Report on Metabolic Neurotransmission Anomaly with Epilepsy, 2023
Clinical and Molecular Characterization of Neurotransmitter Metabolism Disorders, Neurology Journal, 2022
Diagnostic Criteria for Metabolic Epilepsies, Epilepsia, 2021
